Polling concluded peacefully across the combined East Godavari, West Godavari and North Andhra districts. Demonstrating remarkable determination, voters crossed streams, walked through hills and difficult terrain, and used boats and traditional dolis to reach polling stations and exercise their democratic rights. Volunteers and police personnel extended support to elderly voters and those unable to walk. The efforts of senior citizens who overcame several challenges to cast their votes stood out as an inspiring example of civic participation.
